reviews.scope: Every trust boundary the release touches: saved secrets and redaction (audit, editor history, saved queries, saved session, Readyset values, Parameters), group consent and saved-password logins, the local HTTP server, Electron shell, client discovery and Shell launches, release flow, rendered server text. Re-pass: no Critical, High or Medium.
follow_ups: Redaction (Low): a URL user name containing [ is not redacted; a secret SET after a SET word with no assignment in a script without semicolons keeps a non-literal value; doubled or backslash-escaped quotes inside dynamic SQL strings; custom DELIMITER scripts can lose text after a hidden value in stored copies (fails closed); MariaDB /*!! reversed comments; a validated prototype exists.
Topology (Low): the Replication place's tier identity lacks ssh_host, which can link a local Readyset to an SSH-reached server as verified when host names collide.
